moments.text: IR view: crosshair over plain grey, a large round glow just below it, dark rings at right, and a faint speck right of the crosshair.
Picture breaks into colour blocks, goes solid blue for 2 s, then flat grainy grey until a white flash at 28.5 s restores the glow.
A bright point trailing a long white line crosses the upper frame left to right; it exits right at 1:26, the line lingering until 1:32.
Zoom in: the glow swells and the speck becomes a small bright blob just below the crosshair; it then wanders all around the crosshair.
Zoom out: the glow shrinks and the corners darken (dim grey 2:50–2:55); the blob becomes a tiny dot circling close to the crosshair.
Zoomed in again: the blob moves from upper left of the crosshair down to the far left by 3:37, then back beneath it.
Dim opening look returns, with grey side bars; a faint dot drifts just left of the crosshair. Black frame at 4:13, white flash at 4:17.
Flat, grainy grey view with no glow; from 4:59 a tiny white dot holds nearly still lower right. White and black frames follow at 5:06.
Zoomed out again, tiny dot near the crosshair. At 5:29 a square gate frames the crosshair, then corner brackets drop onto the glow until 5:35.
Zoomed in for two minutes: the blob roams widely, reaching the left edge near 7:06 and the right edge near 7:27 before swinging back.
Zoom out, then rapid mode changes with white flashes; from 8:34 to 8:42 a plain grey view with a bright band along the bottom.
Zoomed in again: the blob starts just below the crosshair, swings to the far left at 9:06, then roams upper right.
The sensor now faces a horizon: noisy grey sky above a bright textured layer, thin white streaks across the sky near the crosshair.
